justification: Standard: three display defects on the provisions page (wrong plan name, a false 'not loaded' note, literal table markup). No value served changes; the plan name and table cells now come from data already held instead of a hand-typed table and raw markup.

pre_impl.existing_data: dcp_chapter_registry.dcp_name already names each chapter's plan (31 councils measured); regulatory_provisions holds 1,064 served rules with 2,538 closed HTML tables, table tags only, no script/img/link/handler.
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The page assumed a fixed council-to-plan name; the registry shows 8 councils served from a different plan or year (Waverley 2022 not 2012, Northern Beaches from Warringah DCP 2011). The text renderer assumed provision text is prose; 2,538 tables were printed as tags.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Reused the registry query already in for-property (added dcp_name to its SELECT) instead of a new endpoint; no existing table parser existed (provision-text-formatter has no HTML handling, sanitize.ts only serves innerHTML views).

falsifiable_check.fails_when: DQ-125 exits 1 when any served renderer stops routing text through provision-tables.ts or a served rule holds an unclosed table; DQ-123 exits 1 while councilDcpNames exists with a wrong year; DQ-124 exits 1 when the note renders unconditionally.
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Forced on the PDF renderer 2026-10-04: DQ-125 exit 1 naming components/pdf/ProvisionTable.tsx. On origin/main DQ-123 read 8 councils and DQ-124 unconditional (exit 1).

functions.name: splitProvisionTables
functions.input: provision_text from regulatory_provisions, possibly holding extractor HTML tables
functions.output: ordered prose and table segments; tables as string rows with entirely-empty columns dropped
functions.if_none: text without a table returns one unchanged text segment; an unclosed table is left as text and counted by DQ-125

functions.name: for-property GET dcp_names
functions.input: served provisions with source_chapter_key, and dcp_chapter_registry rows for the council
functions.output: meta.dcp_currency.dcp_names: registry plan names with provision counts, most first
functions.if_none: empty list; the currency line is not rendered rather than naming a guessed plan

queries.purpose: registry plan name per chapter for the requested council
queries.if_zero: no dcp_names, so the currency line is hidden; nothing hardcoded is shown in its place
queries.if_wrong: the name shown is the registry's own dcp_name, the same source DQ-123's check compares against

break_it.scenario: A provision row carries table markup with a script or event-handler attribute
break_it.what_happens: Injected HTML would run in the reader's browser if rendered via innerHTML
break_it.how: cells become plain strings rendered by React; tags are stripped from cell text, nothing reaches innerHTML
break_it.repro: measured 0 served rows with script/iframe/img/a/style/on*= tags; parser has no innerHTML path

break_it.scenario: A table whose header and values sit in different columns (Waverley side setback)
break_it.what_happens: Dropping columns could detach a value from its header and misstate the control
break_it.how: only columns empty in every row are dropped; all values keep their original column order
break_it.repro: jest provision-tables: keeps every value and drops only columns empty in every row

break_it.scenario: A served rule holds a with no
break_it.what_happens: The parser leaves it as prose and the literal markup would still show on screen
break_it.how: DQ-125 counts such rows and goes red; measured 0 on 2026-10-04

break_it.scenario: A property served from two plans (e.g. Ku-ring-gai rows tagged 'Ku-ring-gai DCP 2024' and 'Ku-ring-gai DCP')
break_it.what_happens: A single name would hide the second plan the rules on the page come from
break_it.how: dcp_names lists every plan with served rules, most first, joined on the currency line
break_it.repro: registry query shows both spellings for ku_ring_gai; both would print

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes -- after deploy, open a Waverley address (60 Hall St, Bondi Beach) and confirm the currency line names Waverley DCP 2022 and the C2 table renders as a table.
